accuracy.note: 60 of the 1,053 written comments and 20 of the 76 generated descriptions of creature types; the 12 wrong were all written ones, and all 12 were corrected

porting read every instruction of the five parts, and the lockstep showed eight comments wrong, all corrected: the key repeat's two waits (both routines) the wrong way round, random_below's limit of 0, delay_50's length, the interrupt's DI and EI, tape_error after a save, clear_icon_cell's step and short_wait
